capabilities: Load SVG files from an icons folder in the plugin root, .obsidian, or a custom path
Normalize icon colors to currentColor so icons follow the theme
Cache unchanged icons for faster loading
Restart selected plugins or all of Obsidian after loading icons
Reload icons manually via a command
disambiguation: Not an icon editor or picker; it only loads SVG files from a folder into Obsidian's icon list and restarts plugins to register them.
extras: On Obsidian 1.13+ settings appear in the global settings search; the README includes a project-structure section and an architecture breakdown that is more developer-oriented than user-facing.
intentEvidence: Iconic is one of them: an icon missing from that list does not show up in its icon picker and is not drawn at all.
problem: Obsidian plugins read the app's icon list once at load time, so icons added by the user after startup never appear in plugins like Iconic.

relations.evidence: Add Custom Icons loads first: nothing to configure, Iconic picks the icons up when it loads.

summary: Icon loader that scans a vault folder for SVG files, registers them with Obsidian, and restarts plugins so they pick the icons up.
